integrity.proof_basis: Unique arch decomposition, exact transition counts, geometric-sum renewal increments
integrity.scientific_claim: One joint enumeration-and-renewal theorem for subsequence universality of proper words

limitations: The formulas require identical forbidden adjacent-letter pairs over a homogeneous labeled alphabet; not arbitrary finite-type shifts.
The central limit theorem assumes a fixed alphabet size at least three; the binary case is deterministic.
The exact all-length formulas rely on a proof; finite coefficient enumerations alone do not certify the infinite statement.
Equivalent unindexed earlier formulations outside the inspected sources cannot be ruled out.
title: Subsequence-universality law for words with unequal neighbors
